messages.subject: Document list for the Marldon claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Robert,

Following yesterday's call, the documents we need to build the claim:

- The enquiry data pack you sent the suppliers (and the date)
- Marldon's quotation MQ-4471 and any revisions
- The purchase order and Marldon's standard terms
- Full commissioning logs and the failure register
- The Severnvale replacement order and invoices

The enquiry data pack is the key document - if it discloses your true COD loading, their "overloading" defence is in real trouble.

Tom Gallagher

Tom Gallagher
Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP

messages.subject: RE: Document list for the Marldon claim
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

All attached on our side. The enquiry data pack went to Marldon on 9 January 2024 and clearly states our COD loading at 1,900-2,200 mg/l. Tom Morrow (our process engineer) confirms Marldon sized the plant on 1,200 mg/l, which is simply wrong. Tom can speak to the membrane and pump technical points.

Robert
